## 🚀 Release Management Request

### 🎯 Release Type
What type of release management activity is needed?

#### Release Categories
- [ ] **Major Release** - New major version (X.0.0) with breaking changes
- [ ] **Minor Release** - New minor version (X.Y.0) with new features
- [ ] **Patch Release** - Patch version (X.Y.Z) with bug fixes
- [ ] **Hotfix Release** - Emergency fix for critical issues
- [ ] **Beta Release** - Beta version for testing
- [ ] **Release Candidate** - Release candidate for final testing
- [ ] **Rolling Release** - Continuous deployment update
- [ ] **Feature Release** - Feature-specific release

#### Release Activities
- [ ] **Release Planning** - Plan upcoming release schedule and content
- [ ] **Version Bumping** - Update version numbers and dependencies
- [ ] **Build Preparation** - Prepare build artifacts and packages
- [ ] **Deployment Coordination** - Coordinate deployment across environments
- [ ] **Release Notes** - Generate and publish release notes
- [ ] **Marketing Materials** - Prepare marketing and communication materials
- [ ] **Customer Communication** - Communicate release to customers
- [ ] **Post-Release Analysis** - Analyze release success and issues
